title: Improper input validation in the AWS-managed AWS Systems Manager Automation runbook… (CVE-2026-134070)
description: CVE-2026-134070 is an improper input validation vulnerability in the AWS-managed Systems Manager Automation runbook AWSConfigRemediation-EnableSystemsManagerSessionManagerAuditLogsToS3. It allows an authenticated user permitted to run the runbook to inject unintended configuration, including arbitrary commands, into the Regional Session Manager preferences document if it does not already exist. This can lead to command execution on managed instances when other users start Session Manager sessions. The issue persists until earlier runbook revisions are deprecated or prevented from running. AWS is deprecating all revisions created before 2026-10-22 starting January 15, 2027. Mitigation involves running the latest runbook revision, restricting untrusted users from running earlier revisions, or maintaining a trusted preferences document.
